name: DarkMeta Dark Mode
author: Kazi Rabiul Islam

sections.description:
DarkMeta Dark Mode is a lightweight and customizable WordPress plugin that allows users to switch between light and dark mode seamlessly. This enhances user experience, reduces eye strain, and improves website accessibility.

Features:

⭐ Enable / Disable option added.

🏆 User-friendly dark mode toggle button.

💾 Remembers user preferences using local storage.

🎨 Customizable colors for dark mode.

🔄 Customizable light and dark mode icons.

🔧 Works on frontend and admin dashboard.

🌐 Fully compatible with all WordPress themes and plugins.

⚡ Optimized for performance with minimal impact on page load speed.

❓Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

1️⃣ Does this plugin work with any WordPress theme?
Ans: Yes! DarkMate Dark Mode is designed to be fully compatible with any WordPress theme. It integrates seamlessly without affecting your existing design.

2️⃣ Can I customize the colors of dark mode?
Absolutely! You can set custom background and text colors in the settings to match your branding and website aesthetic.

3️⃣ Will dark mode activate automatically for visitors?
Ans: By default, users can manually enable dark mode. However, you can set it to follow the user’s system preference or enable dark mode by default.

4️⃣ Does this plugin store user preferences?
Ans: Yes! DarkMate Dark Mode remembers user selections using local storage, so their preferred mode stays enabled even after refreshing the page.

5️⃣ Does enabling dark mode impact website performance?
Ans: Not at all! The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance, ensuring your website loads quickly while providing a smooth dark mode experience.

6️⃣ How can I disable Dark Mode?
Ans: You can go to Settings > DarkMate Dark Mode and uncheck the Enable Dark Mode option. This will turn off dark mode without deactivating the plugin.

7️⃣ Can I change the dark mode toggle button icon?
Ans: Yes! You can customize the light and dark mode icons from the settings page, choosing from various icons or adding your own custom ones.

8️⃣ Is DarkMate Dark Mode compatible with page builders like Elementor or Gutenberg?
Ans: Yes! The plugin works perfectly with Elementor, Gutenberg, and other page builders without any conflicts.

9️⃣ Can I schedule dark mode to activate at a specific time?
Ans: Currently, this feature is not built-in, but we are considering adding it in future updates. Stay tuned!

🔟 Does DarkMate Dark Mode support multilingual websites?
Ans: Yes! The plugin is fully translatable and works with popular multilingual plugins like WPML and Polylang.
sections.installation:
📥 Download the plugin zip file.

📂 Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.

✅ Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.

⚙️ Navigate to Settings > DarkMeta Dark Mode to configure plugin settings.
